expectation: every listed document must pass schema validation and every semantic rule

vectors.covers: Smallest legal full map: worldspawn, one convex cube, classic projection.
The real e1m4 opposed_pair func_door package, prefab-local frame with a recorded translation back to source world.
Valve 220 face syntax: explicit u_axis and v_axis alongside rotation and scale.
Quake 2-style trailing numeric face values preserved verbatim in tail.
A repeated key and a property that follows a brush: ordered content round-trips both.
Cropped context: a synthetic cap face carrying synthetic true and synthetic_reason context_crop.
Objects created by a user operation: ids derived from document_id, operation_id and ordinal, so journal replay reproduces them.
activation_source and entity_target edges referencing stable entity ids.
Brushless point entities: an entity may legally carry no brush at all.
Package-scoped identity: ids derived from package_id, document role and the object path inside the document. This is the policy AIM's prefab export uses.
Namespaced extensions at document and entity scope; unknown vendor data never weakens the core schema.
